pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: match the two tables for 2023 and show each district ANC percent with employment percent
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T1.district, CAST(T2.anc4_completed AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(NULLIF(T1.women_enrolled, 0), 0) AS anc_percent, CAST(T1.employed_at_6_months AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(NULLIF(T1.women_enrolled, 0), 0) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS T2 INNER JOIN livelihoods AS T1 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.year = 2023
